story.title: Greenpeace Protests Big Tech with Giant Banner in Switzerland
story.summary: On November 6, Greenpeace activists displayed a large 26-by-26-meter banner outside a data center construction site in Beringen, northeastern Switzerland. The protest aimed to highlight the environmental impact of major technology companies.

event_overview.title: About Protests in Tehran Mark 1979 US Embassy Takeover with Banner Burning
event_overview.subject: Protests in Tehran Mark 1979 US Embassy Takeover with Banner Burning
event_overview.summary: The Tehran demonstrations are part of Iran’s annual November 4 (13 Aban) commemoration of the 1979 seizure of the U.S. Embassy, an episode that led to the Iran hostage crisis. In Iran, the date is also observed as Student Day and the National Day of the Fight against Global Arrogance; rallies commonly take place in Tehran and other cities and feature criticism of U.S. policy.

facts.label: Commemorative date
facts.value: The observance is held annually on November 4, corresponding to 13 Aban in the Iranian calendar, and is officially described in Iranian state coverage as the National Day of the Fight against Global Arrogance and Student Day.

facts.label: Historical origin
facts.value: Iranian students seized the U.S. Embassy in Tehran on November 4, 1979, taking U.S. personnel hostage amid the aftermath of Iran’s revolution.

facts.label: Location and format
facts.value: The focal Tehran gathering is held around the former U.S. Embassy; recent coverage described a march from Palestine Square toward the former embassy, alongside simultaneous demonstrations elsewhere in Iran.

facts.label: Stated purpose in Iranian official cover
facts.value: Iranian state reporting presents the rallies as a commemoration of the embassy takeover and as protests against what it characterizes as U.S. hostility toward Iran.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers a specific 2026 news development about the Tehran commemoration and a separate Greenpeace protest in Switzerland; it does not provide a complete record of the hostage crisis, all Iranian November 4 events, or wider U.S.-Iran relations.

related_stories.title: Amateur Cricketer 'Clicky Ponting' Receives Two-Year Ban for Cheating
related_stories.summary: An amateur cricketer known as 'Clicky Ponting' has been banned from cricket for two years due to cheating during matches. He was found to have been clicking his fingers while fielding to deceive the umpire into believing that the batsman had edged the ball.

related_stories.title: Almería Hosts 36th Annual Vintage Car Rally Celebrating Motoring History
related_stories.summary: Approximately 40 vintage and classic cars participated in the 36th annual rally in Almería, Spain. The event featured vehicles from various eras, including a rare 1905 Vermorel and a DeLorean, highlighting over a century of automotive history.
